comment: trap.c immune_to_trap() reads `is_you && (Levitation || Flying)`, and youprop.h's Flying counts a flying steed. A level-30 debug-mode Knight rides a created saddled red dragon, wishes a pit under itself, reveals it with ^E, steps off and back. With paranoid_confirmation:trap, hack.c asks "Really ... that pit?" only when the hero is not clearly immune, so C flies over the pit without a prompt.
